notes.52v.a.8: Raguel, Barachiel, Pantassaron and Tobiel are kept as the text names them. Barachiel is named twice, for doubt and for court.

nodes.text: These are the names that you should keep in
your mind at all
times. When you get up in the morning,
keep St Michael in your
mind; you will be glad all day.
When you hear thunder, keep St Gabriel
in your mind; then nothing
will harm you. When you want to go
anywhere, keep St Raphael in your
mind; the way will be easy for you.
And when you eat or drink,
keep St Raguel in your mind;
then you will have enough. When you are in
doubt, keep Barachiel
in your mind; everything will be
revealed to you. When you come to a feast,
keep the angel Pantassaron
in your mind; there will come to you all
joy. Keep Uriel in your
mind against the enemy; then you will
win. Keep Barachiel in your mind when
you come to court; everything will go as
you wish. When you step into the ship,
keep Uriel in your mind, and Tobiel;
you will travel happily. In your distress
keep the angel Uriel in your mind, and
say your Our Father, and the verses of Blaise:
'Lord Jesus Christ, our true God, through the prayer
